description: You know if it’s going to stick or if it’s time to remove it, don’t allow things to overstay their welcome #selflove #selfmastery #selfpreservation
transcript: When I choose to add something new to my life, I look at how well it naturally integrates into my world. If it doesn't, I remove it gracefully. I give it permission to leave. I don't keep anything in my life longer than necessary.
